Inventory Management

Excellent English verbal and written communication.

Familiarity with accounting applications, modules, and financial statements.

Motivation to exceed expectations while working independently

Friendly, fast learner who can adapt to change and have a “can-do” attitude

REQUIRED Headset: Noise-cancelling headset connected via USB port

REQUIRED WebCam: At least 3 megapixels capable of 720p recording

title: International Tour Product & Operations Specialist
description:
Full-time independent contractor



Compensation: PHP 55,000–75,000 per month *as a fixed contractor payment, depending on directly relevant experience and demonstrated capability.*



This is for an experienced travel professional who can transform a destination idea into an unforgettable journey.



We are a small European adventure-travel company that organises group hiking and adventure tours for local customers. Our destinations include Nepal, Japan, Peru and destinations across Africa and Europe.



We are looking for a Philippines-based tour professional who can help us research, develop, publish and operate international tours. You will work directly with destination management companies, evaluate complex travel arrangements, maintain accurate budgets and support customers throughout the booking and pre-departure process.



What You’ll Own



Research and evaluate destination management companies in countries around the world.



Arrange and manage direct bookings for flights, accommodation, transfers and other travel services, including confirmations, payment deadlines and changes.



Work with DMCs to develop distinctive itineraries for European adventure travellers.



Assess hotels, guides, transportation, activities, trekking arrangements and meal plans.



Prepare detailed tour budgets and accurate selling-price calculations.



Compare supplier proposals and identify missing services, unclear assumptions and financial risks.



Create clear itineraries, customer FAQs, packing information and pre-departure documents.



Publish new tours and maintain accurate tour information on our website.



Manage bookings, balance payments, passenger information and important deadlines.



Answer routine customer questions professionally by
.



Maintain organised records of supplier agreements, quotations, payments and tour status.



Monitor each departure and identify potential problems before they become emergencies.



Use AI responsibly for research and drafting while independently verifying prices, dates, entry requirements and other important information.



Promptly inform the company owner of any safety, financial, contractual or unusual matters that require review or a decision.



What Success Looks Like



Tour proposals are complete, accurate and commercially realistic.



Budgets contain verified prices, realistic assumptions and clearly documented margins.



Supplier and customer deadlines are consistently met, with any risk of delay communicated early.



Passenger records and booking information remain current.



Customer documents are accurate, helpful and delivered on time.



Risks, errors and operational changes are communicated promptly.



DMCs and customers receive professional and timely communication.



The owner can see the current status of every tour without searching through
s and spreadsheets.



Required Experience



At least three years of experience in outbound tour operations, tour-product development, DMC contracting, adventure travel or a closely related position.



Experience communicating with international suppliers.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.



Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.



Sound commercial judgement and problem-solving ability.



Ability to manage multiple departures, deadlines and supplier relationships.



Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



Reliable computer, internet connection and backup connectivity.



Working Arrangement



Fully remote position based in the Philippines



Ongoing, full-time independent-contractor engagement



Approximately 40 hours of weekly capacity



Working hours that overlap with the European morning, with the working day ending no later than 7:00 p.m. Philippine time



Regular communication with the company owner



Fixed monthly contractor payment covering the agreed capacity and responsibilities



Initial onboarding, training and documented operating procedures



Performance evaluated through accuracy, completed work, deadlines, communication and operational results



How to Apply



Please submit:



Your CV.



A short description of your experience working on international tours.



Your expected monthly contractor payment for a full-time engagement.



Your available working hours in Philippine time.

title: AI Influencer Content Creator
description:
Overview:

Edit AI-generated short-form content for social media personas. You'll take provided scripts and AI-generated images/video clips (generated via Google Flow using Omni Flash) and turn them into finished videos modeled after existing viral video formats, using CapCut for assembly.



Responsibilities:



Produce 4–6 *quality* finished short-form videos per day

Follow provided scripts and reference videos closely for pacing, structure, and format

Use provided AI-generated persona images/clips as the visual base for each video

Edit in CapCut: cuts, captions, pacing,

Flag any script/image issues before starting edits to avoid rework



Requirements:



Strong CapCut editing skills (fast turnaround, clean cuts)

Ability to match pacing/style of a reference video closely

Familiarity with AI-generated video/image workflows (Google Flows Omni Flash and Nano Banana)

Reliable daily availability, full-time hours

Good communication for quick revision turnaround



Time Expectation:

Each video averages 1.5 minutes long, averaging 45 minutes of work for each video depending on complexity. This is a full-time role (~6+ hours/day).



Compensation:



Paid per video

Cash bonuses on top of your base pay for strong view counts and sales performance

Opportunity to grow your wage as the business grows

description:
Part-Time Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — Remote, 4 hrs/day



Flowgent AI, an AI automation agency for B2B companies, is looking for a part-time cold caller to book appointments. You'll call business owners from lists we provide, deliver our pitch, handle objections, and book meetings on our calendar. No closing, no demos — just set the appointment. High volume — around 400 dials/day on a power dialer.



You need: fluent clear spoken English, 1+ year cold calling/SDR/appointment setting experience, thick skin, reliable internet and a quiet space, and the discipline to work unsupervised.



Pay: $240–$300/month fixed base salary, paid through OnlineJobs.ph. No commission — steady pay for steady work.



Hours: 4 hrs/day, Mon–Fri (20 hrs/week). All calling is into US time zones during US business hours, so expect a night shift if you're in Asia. Work from anywhere.



Target: minimum 8 booked appointments per week.



We provide the leads, scripts, our own dialer and CRM, and paid training.



To apply: send your cold calling background, your dial and booking numbers, and the US hours you can work.

title: Virtual Receptionist VA (Remote) | Fast Hiring – 24-Hour Review
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. /month base, room to grow)

---



I produce and sell ~100-page PDF ebooks across my YouTube channels. The entire production workflow runs through Claude — you'll iterate with Claude to produce the book content, the image prompts, and the marketing material. I'll provide the Claude account.



This is not a design job. This is a Claude iteration job. title: Vibe Coder (Full-Time)
description:
Company Overview

We operate a growing network of YouTube channels in the gardening, homesteading, and lawn care niches. Our operation is powered by a custom-built AI production platform called GardenFlow that automates the entire video production pipeline — from script generation and voiceover synthesis to thumbnail creation and Google Drive delivery. We are a small, fast-moving team that ships daily and treats AI tools as force multipliers, not novelties.

We are looking for a Vibe Coder / Prompt Engineer to join the team full-time and take ownership of building, extending, and maintaining the AI-powered tools and workflows that run this operation.

What You Will Do

Your primary responsibility is building and improving the internal tools that power our YouTube channel network. This is not a traditional software engineering role — you will work almost exclusively through AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude, Manus) to ship features, fix bugs, and build new products. The role breaks down into three areas:

Platform Development & Maintenance. You will own the day-to-day development of GardenFlow, our production web application built with React, TypeScript, tRPC, and Tailwind. This includes fixing bugs, shipping new features, improving the UI/UX, and keeping the platform stable as we scale. You will also build and maintain API integrations with third-party services (image/video generation providers, TTS providers, YouTube Data API, Google Drive API).

Analytics & Reporting. You will build a centralized analytics dashboard — an admin panel behind our webstores — that serves as a single pane of glass for the entire operation. On the webstore side, this means tracking revenue, conversion rates, average order value, customer lifetime value, traffic sources, abandoned carts, and funnel drop-off. On the YouTube side, this means pulling in views, click-through rates, watch time, subscriber growth, and revenue per channel. The goal is to give the team real-time visibility into what is working and what is not, without needing to check five different platforms.

New Product Development. As the operation grows, you will help build new consumer-facing products — including ebook webstores with Stripe payments,
 delivery, and A/B testing. Down the line, this may expand to include a consumer mobile app (think PictureThis-style plant identification) and other digital products in the gardening space.

What We Are Looking For

You must be highly proficient with AI coding tools. This means you can take a feature request, break it down, prompt an AI assistant to generate the code, review and debug the output, and ship it — all within hours, not days. You should be comfortable working with React/TypeScript/Node.js codebases even if you did not write every line by hand. You need to understand what the code does, why it works, and how to fix it when it breaks.

You must be a proactive self-starter. This is a small team. Nobody will write you a detailed spec or hold your hand through implementation. You will get a Loom video or a 
 message describing what needs to happen, and you figure out the rest. If something is broken, you investigate before being asked. If you see an opportunity to improve a workflow, you flag it and build it.

You must be chronically online and responsive. This is a remote role, but we move fast. Your core working hours are 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM Manila Time (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM CET), Monday through Saturday. During these hours, you are expected to be actively working and reachable. Outside of core hours (and excluding Sundays), you must be reachable via 
 mobile in case of emergencies — you are the only code person on the team, so if the webapp breaks at an odd hour, you are the one we call. Sundays are fully off. This is not a role where you clock in and clock out — we need someone who genuinely cares about keeping the operation running.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

Experience with any of the following is a plus but not a dealbreaker: building analytics dashboards or working with YouTube Analytics / Google Analytics APIs; Stripe payment integration and e-commerce flows; prompt engineering for image/video generation models; mobile app development (React Native or Flutter); experience with Drizzle ORM, tRPC, or similar TypeScript-first stacks.

Compensation



Base Retainer (Months 1-3): $600 USD / month

Base Retainer (Month 4+): $800 USD / month (based on performance)

Maximum Monthly Earnings: Up to $2,000 USD / month (base + bonuses)

Payment Method: Wise or Binance

Payment Schedule: Monthly, within 10 business days of invoice



What We Provide

All software subscriptions required for the role are covered by us. This includes AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, Manus), API credits, and any other SaaS tools needed for the job. You are responsible for your own computer, internet connection, and home office setup.

Contract Details



Type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Term: 12 months initial, auto-renewing annually

Hours: Full-time, flexible schedule within core hours

Core Hours: 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM Manila Time (9:00 AM - 6:00 PM CET), Monday to Saturday

On-Call: Reachable via 
 mobile outside core hours (Mon-Sat) for emergencies. Sundays fully off.

Location: Remote

Start Date: ASAP

Exclusivity: Full dedication required — no side projects, no other work.



How to Apply

Send your application with the following:



Link one project that you built with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot, Manus, etc.), and describe what you built, how you built it, how much of it you built, what tools you used, and how long it took you to build it.

Have you used Manus AI before? Simple yes or no.

Do not send a generic cover letter. We want to see that you actually read this post and understand what the role involves.

title: Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Role Summary:



The Maintenance Coordinator is the central point of contact for all maintenance work orders across ABPM's managed portfolio. You'll triage and dispatch tenant-reported issues, receive owner approval,  coordinate scheduling between tenants and vendors, track jobs through completion in Buildium, and make sure vendor compliance documentation (W-9s, certificates of insurance) stays current. You'll work closely with the Director of Finance & Operations and Broker to keep owners informed and repairs moving without unnecessary delay or cost.



Key Responsibilities:



Field and triage incoming maintenance requests from tenants; determine urgency and appropriate vendor assignment.

Create, assign, and track work orders in Buildium from intake through completion.

Verify completed work through photos, tenant confirmation, or field inspections prior to closing work orders.

Manage emergency maintenance requests (e.g., no heat/AC, water leaks, lockouts) and ensure timely after-hours response.

Coordinate scheduling between tenants, vendors, and (when needed) ABPM field staff for access and walkthroughs.

Coordinate utility access, water turn-ons, lockbox access, key distribution, and contractor entry as needed.

Coordinate all maintenance activities during tenant turnovers, including inspections, painting, cleaning, carpet replacement, lawn service, repairs, lock changes, smoke detector compliance, and make-ready scheduling to meet leasing deadlines.

Review move-out inspections and maintenance reports to determine repair scope and coordinate corrective work.

Schedule and coordinate preventative maintenance programs, including HVAC servicing, gutter cleaning, chimney inspections, pest control, and other recurring maintenance as needed.

Maintain the approved vendor list; collect and track W-9s and proof of insurance before work is authorized.

Evaluate vendor quality, pricing, response times, and workmanship; build and maintain relationships with preferred contractors, source new vendors as needed, and flag underperforming vendors to leadership.

Support owner-coordinated maintenance requests, ensuring owner-preferred contractors meet license/insurance requirements before liability shifts to the owner.

Apply ABPM's maintenance coordination markup consistently and accurately across vendor invoices.

Review vendor invoices for accuracy against work orders before submission for payment, and maintain monthly invoice tracking.

title: WordPress Website Developer + SEO & AI Content Specialist
description:
WordPress Website Developer + SEO & AI Content Specialist — Long-Term Opportunity



Part-Time / Full-Time | Temporary to Permanent | UK Working Hours | Weekly Pay



Hi, I’m David.



I run an established digital agency that has been operating for 17 years, and we are expanding rapidly.



I’m looking for a talented WordPress Website Developer who understands that building a website is about much more than simply making it look good.



You need to understand SEO, local SEO, website structure and AI-assisted content creation, and know how to build websites designed to generate real results for local businesses.



What You’ll Be Doing



A large proportion of our clients are local service businesses, so our websites are heavily optimised around services + locations.



For example:



Carpet Cleaning London

Carpet Cleaning Croydon

Electrician Manchester

Electrician Stockport

Plumber Birmingham



You should understand how to build these websites properly, including H1/H2/H3 structure, title tags, meta descriptions, internal linking, URLs, schema, image optimisation, calls to action, site speed and on-page SEO.



You’ll also need to be highly competent using AI to research, plan and create high-quality website content.



We are particularly interested in creating websites and content that perform well not only in traditional Google search, but are also structured to maximise visibility and citations across AI search and answer platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity and other emerging platforms.



We don’t want someone who simply asks AI to “write an SEO page” and copies and pastes the result.



You need to understand search intent, entities, topical relevance, local relevance, useful original content and how to edit AI-generated material into genuinely good website copy.



Skills I’m Looking For



You should be highly proficient with:



WordPress development

Local SEO

On-page SEO

SEO-friendly website architecture

Location / area landing pages

AI-assisted content creation

H1, H2 and H3 structure

Internal linking

Schema / structured data

Technical website optimisation

Mobile optimisation and site speed

Namecheap

SiteGround



Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) would be a major advantage.



This Could Become a Very Long-Term Position



I haven’t advertised for new staff for more than a year.



Instead, as we’ve grown, I’ve been giving additional hours to my existing team. We have now expanded to the point where I need another excellent person to take some of the pressure off them.



We’ve been in the agency space for 17 years.



We have clients who have been with us for 1, 2, 5, 10 and even 17 years.



I also have tea
mbers who have worked with me for 1, 2, 3 and 6 years.



That should tell you something about the type of company we are.



I believe I’m a fair employer. Everyone is paid weekly, every Friday, and if you are good at what you do, reliable and trustworthy, this could become a secure position for many years.



Integrity is everything in our business.



That is what I offer my team, and it is what I expect in return.



I expect 100% loyalty, honesty and commitment so that, as a team, we can continue delivering great results for our clients.



Communication Is Extremely Important



We work predominantly UK hours, although there can be some flexibility where needed.



I communicate with my team regularly through WhatsApp, so you must be responsive during working hours.



We look after real businesses, and sometimes clients need a quick answer. I therefore need someone who communicates clearly and doesn’t disappear for hours when something important needs attention.



You must also have good written and spoken English.



How to Apply — PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY



I have spent considerable time writing this job post because I want to find the right person.



Please spend some time on your application too.



Address your application personally to “David”.



If you address me as “Sir”, I will reject your application.



I prefer being called by my name, David. Some of my team call me Boss, and I’m perfectly happy with either — just not Sir! ????



It’s also a simple way for me to see whether you’ve actually taken the time to read the full job description before applying.



Please include:



A personal introduction explaining why you think you would be a good fit.

Examples of WordPress websites you have personally built.

Examples of SEO/local SEO work, particularly location or area pages.

Evidence of results where possible.

Details of your experience using AI for content creation and SEO.

Details of any GoHighLevel experience you have.

Your current availability and preferred number of hours per week.

Your expected hourly/monthly rate.

A short video introducing yourself, so I can see and hear how you communicate in English.



Please don’t send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Tell me something specific about this job description so I know you’ve actually read it.



Final Stage



I will shortlist the strongest applicants and expect to invite approximately two candidates to complete a small test build.



The test will only be completed on a test website, staging website or new test page — never on a live client website.



We do not profit from test work.



The purpose is simply to verify that your practical ability matches your portfolio and application.



Please note that the test is unpaid, so only apply if you are comfortable with this.



I have had too many experiences in the past where someone's claimed ability simply didn't match their actual work. A short practical test allows both of us to know whether the role is the right fit before making a longer-term commitment.



A Little About Our Team



I already have several fantastic tea
mbers in the Philippines, and I’ve had a great experience building a team there.



I value the work ethic, loyalty and commitment I’ve experienced from my Filipino tea
mbers, and I’m very happy to be recruiting in the Philippines again.



I haven’t needed to recruit for over a year because I prefer to look after good people, give them more hours and keep them with us for the long term rather than constantly replacing staff.



Our growth has now reached the point where my existing team has more than enough work, and I need to bring another talented person onboard.



Could This Be You?



I’m looking forward to meeting the next rising star.



You might already be excellent at what you do, but just as importantly, I want someone who is hungry to learn, improve and take their skills to the next level.



I’m not looking for someone who wants to work with us for a few weeks and then disappear.



For the right person, this could develop from part-time or temporary work into a permanent, full-time and genuinely long-term position.



If you’re looking for somewhere you can potentially work for years rather than months, I would genuinely like to hear from you.



I look forward to reading your application.



David

title: Remote Sales & Appointment Specialist – U.S. Tech Retail
description:
We are looking for an experienced Remote Sales & Appointment Specialist to support multiple U.S.-based technology retail locations.



This is a sales-focused contract position, not a general virtual assistant role. You will primarily make outbound calls, sell Asurion Tech Care plans, schedule store appointments, follow up with customers, and connect customers with the appropriate store when additional assistance is needed.



Responsibilities



* Make outbound sales and follow-up calls to U.S.-based customers

* Sell Asurion Tech Care plans

* Schedule customer appointments at the appropriate store

* Follow up on leads, previous conversations, and sales opportunities

* Maintain and work an active customer pipeline

* Redirect customers to the appropriate store when additional in-store assistance is needed

* Manage calls, appointments, and follow-ups across multiple locations

* Accurately document calls, appointments, sales, and customer outcomes

* Consistently work toward established sales and appointment goals



Compensation



Base Pay: $4.00 USD/hour



In addition to hourly pay, you will earn commission for each qualifying Tech Care sale:



* 5-Device Plan: +$2.00 per sale

* 10-Device Plan: +$4.00 per sale

* 15-Device Plan: +$6.00 per sale



There is no limit to the number of qualifying sales you can earn commission on.



Pay Schedule: Bi-weekly

Payment Method: PayPal only



This is a contract-based position.



Sales Performance Expectations



This is a performance-driven sales position. Contractors are expected to consistently develop their sales results and work toward established monthly goals.



Our current monthly performance levels are:



* 5 Sales – Minimum Requirement: Contractors must complete at least 5 qualifying sales per month to maintain the position.

* 10 Sales – Performance Standard: Established contractors are expected to consistently achieve at least 10 qualifying sales per month.

* 20 Sales – Monthly Target: Our target for each Sales & Appointment Specialist is 20 qualifying sales per month.

* 20+ Sales – Strong Performance: Contractors who consistently meet or exceed the monthly target will be recognized as strong performers and may be considered for additional opportunities and performance incentives as the program grows.



Performance is not measured by sales alone. Call activity, appointments scheduled, follow-up activity, attendance, documentation, customer interactions, and overall productivity will also be considered.



Falling below 5 qualifying sales in a month may result in termination of the contract.



Contractors who remain above the minimum but consistently perform below the expected standard may receive additional coaching and a performance improvement period.



The goal is not simply to maintain the minimum. We are looking for sales professionals who consistently work toward and exceed the monthly target.



Schedule



* 5 days on / 2 days off

* Working hours will fall between 10:00 AM and 7:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

* Exact working days may vary based on business needs

* Clock-in/clock-out tracking is required for payroll and attendance purposes



Reliable attendance and punctuality are required.



What We’re Looking For



This position requires someone who is already comfortable selling.



Ideal candidates should have:



* Strong previous sales experience

* Phone sales, telesales, outbound calling, call center, or appointment-setting experience

* Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation and strong conversational fluency

* Confidence speaking with U.S.-based customers

* Strong closing and objection-handling skills

* Ability to multitask and manage activity across multiple store locations

* Strong organization and follow-up habits

* Ability to work independently and remain accountable for results

* Reliable computer/laptop and high-speed internet

* Quality headset/microphone

* Quiet and professional calling environment



Experience selling technology, telecommunications, subscriptions, protection plans, insurance, or other service-based products is a plus.



Training



Training will be provided covering:



* Asurion Tech Care products and plan options

* Sales processes and expectations

* Appointment scheduling

* Customer follow-up procedures

* Systems and documentation

* Store operations and escalation procedures



We will provide the product and process training. We are looking for candidates who already bring the confidence, communication skills, work ethic, and sales mentality required to succeed.



How to Apply



Start your application with the words “TECH SALES.”



Please provide:



* Your current resume

* A brief description of your previous sales experience

* Any experience with outbound calling or appointment setting

* Any experience working with or selling to U.S.-based customers

* Confirmation that you can work between 10:00 AM–7:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

* Confirmation that you can receive payment through PayPal

* A 30–60 second voice recording



Voice Recording



Introduce yourself, briefly describe your sales experience, and tell us why you believe you would be successful selling technology services over the phone.



The recording should allow us to hear your natural communication style. No special equipment or professional recording is necessary.



Applications without both a resume and voice recording will not be considered.



Interview Process



Applications will be reviewed based on relevant experience, sales background, communication skills, and overall fit.



Selected applicants will be contacted for an interview as the next step in the hiring process.



How to Book Your Interview



To speed things up, you can schedule your own interview as soon as you have applied. There is no need to wait to be contacted.







The interview is a 15-minute conversation on Microsoft Teams. After booking you will receive a calendar invite by
 with the join link. All times shown are Eastern Standard Time (EST).



Please make sure you have also submitted your resume and voice recording. Interviews without a completed application will not go ahead.

title: Virtual Assistant — UK/Europe Comedy Touring Business (long-term, Tue–Sat)
description:
We're hiring a full-time Virtual Assistant to help run the day-to-day operations of a touring comedy business.



We provide training for everything we do, and our regular processes are documented in step-by-step guides, so you don't need previous experience with our systems.



What matters much more to us is how you think and work.



We're looking for someone with exceptional attention to detail who spots errors before they become problems, follows instructions precisely, works quickly and can operate independently once trained.



This is a fast-moving role involving lots of
s, dates, cities, ticketing platforms, travel arrangements and spreadsheets. You need to be able to keep track of multiple things at once, prioritise what needs attention and think logically about how everything fits together.



What you'll be doing



Helping make the tour work. You'll be working across multiple European cities and tour dates at the same time. This means checking dates, locations, travel connections, venue availability and existing bookings to make sure the schedule actually works. You need to be able to spot conflicts and potential problems rather than simply entering the information you're given.



Keeping ticket sales moving. Every morning, an automated report shows how every show is selling. You'll work through it, identify shows that need attention, close sold-out shows on our ticketing platforms, make required updates and ensure everything is logged correctly. We use TicketTailor, Eventbrite and Fienta, and we'll train you on all three.



Analysing previous tour data. You'll regularly look at information from previous shows and tours, including ticket sales, prices, costs, venues and performance by city, to help us make better decisions about future dates. You don't need to be a data analyst, but you do need to be comfortable comparing information, spotting patterns and identifying inconsistencies.



Keeping our tracking spreadsheets accurate. Venue fees, flights, accommodation, ticket prices, show statuses and other information all need to be entered and updated in Google Sheets. These spreadsheets feed into other parts of our operations, so a small error can create a much bigger problem. Accuracy and checking your own work are essential.



Handling a high volume of
s. You'll communicate with venues, ticketing platforms, suppliers and other contacts. You'll need to stay on top of multiple conversations, follow up when people haven't replied, notice when information doesn't match our records and make sure nothing important gets missed.



Booking travel and dealing with venues. You'll research and book flights and accommodation for tour dates across Europe, confirm venue arrangements in writing and log everything correctly. This requires thinking ahead: a cheap flight isn't useful if it lands too late for the show, and two good venues aren't useful if it's impossible to travel between the cities in time.



Fixing
 and Instagram ads. Our system identifies problems with ads and creates tasks explaining exactly what needs to be changed. You'll make those changes manually in Meta Ads Manager, following the instructions precisely. No previous ads experience is required, but you must be very good at following detailed instructions without skipping steps.



Promoting shows. You'll post in relevant local
 groups, create
 events, send
 campaigns through Mailchimp and make simple graphics in Canva.





How we work



We need someone who can become independent.



We'll train you, answer questions and give you clear processes, but we're not looking for someone who waits for instructions before doing every task. Once you understand how something works, we expect you to take ownership of it, think about what needs to happen next, notice when something doesn't look right and raise problems before they become urgent.



Speed is also important. There can be a lot happening at once, so you need to be able to work efficiently while maintaining a high level of accuracy.



You'll send a short plan at the beginning of each workday and a short summary at the end. We also have one 15-minute call each week, with most day-to-day communication happening through
.



If something goes wrong, tell us immediately. This includes your own mistakes. We'd much rather hear, "I've spotted a problem and I'm fixing it," straight away than discover it several days later.



The most important qualities for this role:



Exceptional attention to detail — you naturally notice incorrect dates, prices, links, cities, costs and other inconsistencies.

Ability to spot errors — you don't assume information is correct just because someone else entered it.

Independent thinking — once trained, you can work out what needs to happen next without constant supervision.

Following instructions precisely — if a process has six steps, you complete all six.

Speed and organisation — you can handle a large workload efficiently without tasks getting forgotten or overlooked.

Strong written communication — you'll be dealing with a high volume of
s and written instructions every day.

Logical thinking — you can juggle dates, cities, venues, flights and accommodation and understand whether a tour schedule actually works.

Comfort with data — you can compare previous tour results and use that information to identify patterns, errors and useful insights.

Honesty and accountability — if you've made a mistake or don't understand something, you say so immediately.



Pay and hours:

£200 per week, paid weekly via Wise on the same day every week.

Tuesday to Saturday, 8 hours per day.

Working hours: 11AM–8PM UK time, including a one-hour break.

13th month pay in December after more than six months with us.

Philippine regular holidays respected.



This is stable, long-term work. We're looking for someone who can become an important part of the team for years, not months.



Requirements:

Excellent written and spoken English. This is essential because a large part of the role involves reading instructions, writing
s and communicating clearly.

Excellent attention to detail and the ability to spot errors and inconsistencies.

Strong organisation and the ability to manage multiple tasks, cities and dates simultaneously.

Able to work independently and take ownership of tasks after training.

Comfortable working quickly and managing a busy workload.

Comfortable with Google Sheets and basic data analysis.

Reliable internet and computer, with a backup plan for internet or power outages.

Willing to learn Meta Ads Manager, Mailchimp, Canva, ClickUp, TicketTailor, Eventbrite, Fienta and our other systems. We provide training on everything you need to use.



Previous VA experience is not required. We'd rather hire someone smart, careful, organised and willing to learn than someone with years of experience who doesn't pay attention.



How to apply



Write a short application — a few sentences is enough. Please tell us:



Why you think this particular job suits you.

Give us one example of a time you spotted an error or problem that somebody else had missed. What did you do?

Give us a simple example of how you would check whether a proposed tour schedule involving several cities and dates actually works.

Tell us about your internet and power situation, including your backup plan if either goes down.



Please don't send a generic or obviously copy-pasted VA application. We're much more interested in seeing how you think and communicate.



To show us you've read the full job description, put the word milkshake in the subject line of your application. Applications without it will not be read.



Spend 7 apply points.

title: Full-Stack Developer for Insurance Request Tracking SaaS (MVP)
description:
Final payment for development from idea to upload to stores - $600.



We are looking for a **Full-Stack Developer** to build the MVP of **Referent AI**, a simple web-based request tracking and monitoring system for insurance agents in Israel.



### The Idea



Insurance agents regularly submit requests to insurance companies, such as policy changes, new policy issuance, transfers, track updates, withdrawals, cancellations, and other client-related requests.



The main problem is that after submitting a request, agents often have no simple way to track everything in one place. They need to manually check
s, call insurance companies, or remember to follow up.



**Referent AI solves this by acting as a simple tracking layer on top of their existing workflow.**



The agent will continue submitting requests to insurance companies exactly as they do today. After submitting a request, they simply add it to Referent AI.



For example:



An agent submits a policy change request to an insurance company ? adds the client and request to Referent AI ? the system starts tracking how many days have passed ? if the request has not been completed within the expected time, Referent AI alerts the agent.



The goal is very simple:



**Help insurance agents know exactly which requests are open, which require attention, and which are taking too long — without manually remembering everything.**



### What Needs to Be Built



The MVP should include:



* User registration and login

* Each user has their own private account and data

* Simple form to add a new insurance request

* Client name

* Insurance company

* Request type

* Submission date

* Notes

* Expected completion / alert threshold in days

* Request status management:



  * Submitted

  * In Progress

  * Action Required

  * Completed

  * Rejected

* Main dashboard showing all requests

* Clear indication of which requests are overdue/stuck

* Counters for open, overdue, action-required, and completed requests

* Search, filters, and sorting

* Ability to quickly change request status

* Activity/history log for each request

* Automatic monitoring of how long each request has been open

* In-app notifications when a request exceeds its allowed time

*
 alerts for overdue requests

* Notification center

* Basic user settings

* Forgot/reset password

* Trial / Active account status

* Responsive design for desktop and mobile

* Complete **Hebrew RTL interface**



### Important Scope



This is a **focused MVP**, not a complex insurance platform.



There are **no integrations with insurance companies** at this stage.



There is also no need for:



* Automatic
 reading

* Automatic submission to insurance companies

* Native iOS/Android app

* Payment processing

* Complex AI functionality

* Multi-user agency/team system



Everything is entered manually by the insurance agent.



The main focus is creating a **fast, clean and extremely simple system** that non-technical insurance agents can understand immediately.



### Technical Requirements



We are flexible regarding the exact technology stack.



Preferred technologies include:



* React / Next.js

* Node.js or Python

* PostgreSQL / Supabase

* Vercel / AWS or similar hosting



The developer can recommend a different stack if it makes development faster and more reliable.



Security is important because the application contains client information. User data must be completely separated, authentication must be secure, passwords must never be stored in plaintext, and the application must use HTTPS.



### Design



The design should be:



**Modern, minimal, clean and professional.**



The interface will be completely in **Hebrew and RTL**.



The most important UX principle is that when an insurance agent opens the dashboard, within a few seconds they should understand:



**What needs my attention today?**



Adding a new request should take **less than 30 seconds**, and common actions should require only 1–2 clicks.



### Project Terms



**Budget: $600 USD fixed for the complete MVP**



**Development timeframe: Maximum 4 weeks**



We are looking for someone who can take responsibility for the complete MVP — frontend, backend, database, authentication, alert system, responsive UI, and deployment.



At the end of the project, we expect:



* Fully working deployed application

* Complete source code

* Database setup

* All project files

* Deployment/configuration documentation

* Full ownership and access to the project



When applying, please send examples of **SaaS platforms, dashboards, CRM systems, or similar web applications** you have previously developed.



Please also confirm that you understand the scope and can complete the MVP within the **$600 fixed budget and 4-week timeframe**.

title: Project manager
description:
PRIME RENOVATIONS LLC | NEW YORK, NY

Assistant Project Manager / Project Manager (Procore

Owner)

Full time, remote from the Philippines. Long term role with growth.

About us

Prime Renovations is a boutique luxury general contractor in Manhattan. We do high end gut renovations of

co-op and condo apartments, typically $700,000 to $2,000,000 per project, inside occupied prewar and modern

buildings with strict building rules, alteration agreements and tight schedules. Our clients are homeowners,

architects and interior designers who expect the work to be organized and predictable.

The role in one sentence

You own Procore. Every job, every day. If it is not current in Procore, that is on you.

We run our projects in Procore as the single system of record. Right now that system is not being kept current,

and it costs us money and credibility. We are hiring someone who has actually run projects and who takes

personal ownership of the project controls, not someone waiting to be assigned tasks.

What you will do

• Schedules. Build and maintain a published schedule for every active job. Update it weekly at minimum, flag

slippage early, and keep look ahead schedules in front of the field team.

• RFIs. Draft, log, issue and chase every RFI. Nothing sits open without a follow up and a due date.

• Submittals. Build the submittal log from the specs and drawings, route to the architect and designer, track

approvals, and make sure approvals land well before the material is needed on site.

• Commitments and change orders. Every subcontractor and vendor gets an executed commitment in

Procore before work starts or a deposit goes out. Track change events, change orders and invoices against

the budget.

• Budgets and cost tracking. Keep the budget current so we always know where each job stands.

• Procurement tracking. Maintain a long lead item log with order dates, lead times and delivery dates.

• Daily field coordination. Review daily logs and photos, prepare meeting agendas and minutes, and follow

up on open items with the Director of Operations and site team.

• Documents. Keep drawings, specs, permits, insurance certificates and closeout documents organized and

current.

How the day runs

This is a structured role, not an open inbox. You will work to a fixed daily routine, for example a Procore review

and update block first thing, then RFI and submittal follow up, then schedule and procurement updates, then an

end of day summary to the team. We will give you the routine and the checklists. You are expected to run them

without being chased and to tell us when something in the system does not match reality on site.

On hours: we care more about the routine being run than about you sitting at a desk from 9 to 5 Eastern. Most

of our team already works New York hours by choice and we are flexible for the right person. The one part of

this job that cannot run on a delay is RFI and submittal follow up, because architects, designers and suppliers in

New York have to be reachable while you are working. Plan on real overlap with the New York day for that

piece.

What we require

• Three or more years as a project manager, assistant project manager or project coordinator in construction.

Residential renovation or interiors experience preferred.

• Hands on Procore experience. You must be able to set up a project, build a budget, issue commitments, and

run the RFI and submittal workflows without hand holding.

• Ability to read and understand architectural drawings and specifications well enough to build a submittal log

and spot gaps.

• Strong written English. You will be writing to architects, designers and subcontractors in New York.

• Significant daily overlap with New York business hours. Most of our team already works US Eastern hours

by choice, and we are flexible on the exact window for the right person.

• Reliable computer, stable internet and a backup connection.

Nice to have

• Experience with New York City co-op and condo work, alteration agreements or building rules.

• Bluebeam, MS Project, ClickUp, Google Workspace, QuickBooks.

• Estimating or takeoff experience.

Compensation and terms

• Full time, 40 hours per week, aligned to New York business hours.

• Monthly salary depending on experience and Procore depth, paid weekly by Wise.

• 30 day trial period, then a long term engagement.

• Paid Philippine holidays and paid time off after the trial period.

• Real growth path. This role can become the project management lead as we scale.

How to apply

Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be read. This is the first test.

• Put SUBMITTAL LOG as the first two words of your subject line.

• Tell us the largest project you have run or supported, the dollar value, and what your specific responsibility

was.

• Tell us how many months or years you have worked inside Procore and which Procore tools you have

personally used.

• Answer this in three or four sentences: a $45,000 painting subcontractor started work on a job and there is

no commitment, no budget line and no invoice in Procore. Walk us through exactly what you do first, second

and third.

• Optional but it helps: a two to three minute video of you sharing your screen inside Procore, or describing

your Procore workflow if you no longer have access.

Shortlisted candidates will be given a short paid test using a real Prime Renovations plan set. You will build a

submittal log and a basic schedule so we can see how you actually work.

Prime Renovations LLC | 
 | NYC DCWP Home Improvement Contractor License

title: CRM Administration and Customer Engagement (100% Remote)
description:
CRM Administration and Customer Engagement (100% Remote)



Job Description



Company: I Go Panama (
)



Type: Full-time remote position; reliable daily coverage, responsive monitoring and consistent ownership of Zoho CRM implementation and ongoing operations.



About Us

I Go Panama connects English-speaking tourists, digital nomads, prospective residents and expats with trusted Panama information, relevant community organizations and verified local businesses. Our website and social channels serve the community, while Panamanian businesses use I Go Panama to attract qualified customers through Claimed/Yellow Pages, Verificado and Impulso plans.



We are seeking a hands-on CRM Administration and Engagement professional to lead the implementation of Zoho CRM as the replacement for Kommo and Saleshandy, working directly with the owner and coordinating closely with the Account Executive. This role owns end-to-end CRM configuration, automation, omnichannel engagement, routing quality and continuous improvement.



What You Will Do Day-to-Day

You will build and operate one integrated Zoho-centered system for both audiences: individuals who need trusted Panama information and free membership, and businesses or organizations that need the correct directory, verification, paid-plan or partnership pathway. Success means reliable automation, accurate segmentation, prompt engagement and no stranded lead.



Zoho CRM Implementation and Migration: Lead the complete transition from Kommo and Saleshandy to Zoho CRM; inventory existing data and workflows, migrate and clean contacts, configure fields, segments, pipelines, lifecycle stages, assignments, permissions, reporting and integrations, and own testing, launch and continuous optimization with the owner.



Omnichannel Engagement and Intelligent Routing: Consolidate inbound comments, direct messages, website forms and chat,
s, WhatsApp and other supported channels into Zoho; configure bots and automation to identify English versus Spanish, determine the correct pillar and intent, route individuals to useful information and free sign-up, and route business prospects to the right plan or Account Executive.



Sales Automation, Quality Assurance and Coordination: Build automated capture, qualification, nurturing, follow-up, reminders, alerts, handoffs and reporting with the owner and Account Executive; monitor all inbound messages, comments,
s and leads every day; correct misroutes, improve messaging and lead-generation workflows, and keep customer, business and community records accurate.



Channels You Will Connect and Monitor

Core owned channels: 
 website, contact and membership forms, live chat, business
, WhatsApp Business and any supported phone/VOIP or messaging integrations.



I Go Panama — English community:
 Page (
/igopanama.fb),
 Group (
/groups/igopanama), Instagram (
/igo.panama), TikTok 
 YouTube 
 LinkedIn (
/in/igopanama), Mastodon 
 Pinterest (
/IGo_Panama), Google Business/Maps and Reddit (
/user/I_Go_Panama).



Additional or conditional community channels: X/Twitter (x.com/i_go_panama; account currently suspended and to be connected only if reactivated), Bluesky (planned/not yet configured) and other future or TBD channels as integrations become available.



I Go Panama Directory — Spanish business outreach: Instagram (
/igopanamadirectory),
 (
/igopanamadirectory) and TikTok 
 Go Panama HOTELS — English lodging audience: Instagram (
/igo.panama.hotels) and
 (
/IGoPanamaHotels).



Configure supported integrations, monitored queues and routing bots for inbound public comments and private messages; where a platform does not permit native integration, document the limitation and implement the best owner-approved supported workflow.



Audience Pillars and Required Routing Outcomes

Visit — Owner or general manager of a licensed hotel, boutique property, resort, hostel, serviced apartment, vacation rental operation or specialty lodging business. Best fit has professional photos, some English capability, direct-booking capacity and a need to fill rooms outside peak periods. Route toward qualified availability requests and direct bookings.

Experience — Owner-operator of a tour, activity, restaurant, attraction, transport service or recurring event. Best fit has a bookable offer, clear prices or price ranges, reliable schedules and visual material. Route toward booking requests, reservations and event participation.

Relocate — Licensed lawyer, relocation adviser, international mover, school, insurance adviser or specialist serving people moving to Panama. Best fit offers a high-value consultation, verifiable credentials and the ability to respond in English. Route toward qualified consultation requests.

Stay — Licensed broker, property manager, developer, rental operator or senior-living provider with active inventory. Best fit keeps listings current and can serve foreign buyers or renters. Route toward property-specific inquiries and matched buyer/renter requests.

Live — Established local provider serving residents and expats in health, home, auto, finance, education, pets, personal services, shopping or business support. Best fit is verified, responsive and able to explain its service in English. Route toward quote, appointment or contact requests.

Community — Credible nonprofit, civic, volunteer, cultural, faith, professional or support organization with recurring programs, events or volunteer needs. Membership is free and the organization profile is searchable. Route toward volunteers, event attendance, donations through the organization's own verified link and partnership inquiries.

Individual — English-speaking visitor, prospective resident, newcomer or established resident who wants trusted Panama information and personalized updates. Membership is free. The account is private and non-searchable; support
 preferences, saved content and matching to relevant businesses and community organizations.



Performance, Pay and Continuous Improvement

Base compensation is USD $250 every two weeks.

Good performance has a target bonus equal to 10% of base compensation; excellent performance has a target bonus equal to 20% of base compensation.

Performance is assessed against implementation ownership, automation quality, routing accuracy, response coverage, data integrity, community engagement and effective Account Executive handoffs.

A performance review and potential base-rate adjustment are available every three months; an adjustment is not automatic.

Coordinate regularly with the owner and Account Executive to refine bilingual messaging, lead-generation automation, sales follow-up and community support.



Absolute Mandatory Requirements (Core Aptitudes)

Zoho CRM Ownership: Proven hands-on ability to configure Zoho CRM or comparable CRM automation, integrate multiple communication channels, manage pipelines and contact records, and troubleshoot workflow or routing failures without waiting to be told what to do.



Bilingual Written Communication: Professional working proficiency in written English and comfort producing Spanish content using a translator (with polishing done by another tea
mber), with the judgment needed to configure language-aware automation, respond appropriately, maintain clear records and coordinate effectively with the owner and Account Executive (both are bilingual).



Reliability and Daily Monitoring: Dependable remote availability, a stable computer and high-speed internet, consistent daily review of inbound queues and automations, and prompt escalation whenever an individual, business prospect or existing customer is not receiving the correct response.



Implementation Accountability and Intellectual Honesty: Take end-to-end responsibility for migration, testing, launch, documentation and improvement; verify uncertain answers, protect data integrity, and surface integration limitations or operational risks promptly.



Customer-Centered Operational Judgment: Understand the difference between a free individual account, a free Community-organization profile and a commercial business prospect; route each correctly and protect the privacy of non-searchable individual accounts.



Nice-to-Have Qualifications (Hands-on Experience)

Direct implementation experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho automation tools, chatbot configuration, CRM migrations, integrations, lead scoring, sales funnels or multichannel customer-engagement systems.



Experience integrating website forms, live chat,
, WhatsApp Business,
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, Google Business and other supported social or messaging channels.



Familiarity with Panama tourism, relocation, real estate, expat communities, local business marketing, membership directories or the operational needs of small businesses.



A university degree is not required. Demonstrated ownership, strong bilingual judgment, attention to detail and the ability to turn manual processes into reliable automations matter most.

 & Instagram).



This is a high-volume, high-execution role. You won’t be staring at a blank canvas for hours waiting for inspiration; instead, you will be executing on proven frameworks, scaling winning concepts, and rapidly producing creative variations. You must be comfortable producing up to 30 assets per day (including 3 distinct variations per concept) plus handling standard revisions.



If you thrive in a fast-paced DTC environment, understand what makes people stop scrolling, and can maintain quality at speed, this role is for you.



Key Responsibilities

High-Volume Creative Output: Design and deliver up to 30 Meta image ad assets per day based on creative briefs, current trends, and winning account data.



Iterative Design: Create 3 distinct variations for each core concept (e.g., testing different hooks, backgrounds, colorways, or product layouts) to optimize for Meta’s ad auction.

title: Part-Time Amazon EU PPC Digital Marketing & Compliance Specialist (High-Ticket €700+ Products)
description:
Job Title: Part-Time Amazon Germany PPC & Compliance Specialist (High-Ticket €700+ Products) – Work Alongside Our Existing Team



Location: Remote (Open to Philippines-based candidates)

Work Schedule: Part-time (20–25 hours per week), with some overlap with German business hours for team collaboration.



About Us

We are an established brand currently dominating other marketplaces, and we are now expanding into Amazon Germany for the first time.



Our products are premium, high-value goods, with an average selling price of €700+. We have a strong, experienced PPC team already in place—they manage our other markets. Now we need a Germany-dedicated specialist to work alongside them, bringing deep expertise in the German market—not just in PPC, but also in compliance and listing management.



This is a part-time, collaborative role. You won't be working in isolation—you'll be coordinating with our existing team, sharing insights, and executing a coordinated global strategy tailored specifically to Germany.



The Role

We are looking for a part-time Amazon Germany Specialist with deep experience in both PPC and compliance/listing reinstatement to join our team and take ownership of our German advertising and listing health.



You will work closely with our current PPC team to:



Build and scale PPC campaigns for the German market from scratch.



Leverage your Germany-specific knowledge (local search behavior, keyword nuances, seasonality, cultural buying habits) to complement our team's existing expertise.



Execute aggressive, high-volume scaling strategies while maintaining strong ROAS for €700+ products.



Manage compliance issues and lead listing reinstatement efforts when listings are removed or suppressed by Amazon Germany.



This is a collaborative, long-term partnership. We are looking for a teammate who can integrate with our existing workflow and help us win in Germany—while also protecting our listings from the strict German regulatory environment.



Key Responsibilities

PPC & Advertising:



Germany Campaign Ownership: Take full responsibility for PPC campaigns exclusively on Amazon Germany (.de).



Collaboration: Work alongside our existing PPC team, sharing insights, data, and strategies to ensure alignment with our global advertising goals.



Launch Strategy: Build campaigns from zero with no historical German data, using your expertise to identify high-potential keywords and audiences.



Aggressive Scaling: Manage significant daily budgets to capture market share quickly for €700+ products.



Daily Optimization: Monitor bids, search terms, and placements daily. Adjust aggressively to maintain visibility while protecting ROAS.



Keyword Research: Conduct deep, Germany-specific keyword research. Understand that direct translation from English is not enough—you must understand German search intent and colloquialisms.



Localization: Ensure all campaigns are culturally tailored to German buyers (seasonality, holidays, shopping behavior, and language nuances).



Compliance & Listing Management:



Listing Reinstatement: Lead the process of reinstating listings that are removed, suppressed, or flagged by Amazon Germany. This includes writing effective appeal letters, gathering required documentation, and communicating with Amazon Seller Support.



Compliance Monitoring: Proactively monitor listing health and ensure all product listings comply with German regulations (e.g., packaging laws, CE marking, safety standards, language requirements).



Account Health Management: Keep our German account health score in good standing by addressing policy violations, customer complaints, and performance notifications promptly.



Documentation: Maintain organized records of compliance documents, certifications, and appeal correspondence for future reference.



Risk Prevention: Identify potential compliance risks before they become issues and implement preventive measures.



Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with our operations and quality teams to ensure products meet German regulatory requirements before listing.



Requirements (Must-Haves)

PPC Experience:



Minimum 2–3 years managing Amazon PPC specifically for Amazon Germany (.de) with a proven track record of scaling high-ticket products (€100+) .



Experience launching brands or products in the EU marketplace with zero historical data.



Expert-level knowledge of Amazon Advertising Console, Seller Central, and third-party tools (e.g., Perpetua, Pacvue, Helium 10, or Jungle Scout).



Deep understanding of EU consumer behavior, seasonality (e.g., Weihnachtsgeschäft), and local competitor landscape.



Compliance & Reinstatement Experience:



Proven experience successfully reinstating removed or suppressed listings on Amazon Germany.



Deep understanding of German and EU compliance requirements:



VerpackG (German Packaging Act)



WEEE (Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment) if applicable



CE marking and product safety standards



Batteriegesetz (Battery Act) if applicable



GPSR (General Product Safety Regulation)



Language requirements for listings and packaging



Experience writing effective appeal letters to Amazon Seller Performance and navigating German-specific policy enforcement.



Knowledge of Amazon's Account Health dashboard and how to address policy violations.



General Requirements:



Collaborative Mindset: You must be comfortable working remotely alongside an existing team, not in isolation. Strong communication and teamwork skills are essential.



Analytical Skills: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs). You must be comfortable analyzing large datasets and presenting insights clearly.



Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and resolve complex compliance issues independently.



English Proficiency: Excellent written and spoken English (German language skills are a bonus but not required).



Long-Term Commitment: We are looking for a long-term partner who can grow with us as we scale in Germany.



Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)

Knowledge of the German language (reading/writing) to better understand search term reports, competitor listings, and German compliance documents.



Experience with Amazon Brand Analytics and Search Query Performance specifically for Germany.



Experience managing budgets of €1,000+ per month.



Existing relationships or contacts within Amazon Seller Support (German team).





Collaborative Environment: You won't be alone—you'll be part of a supportive, experienced PPC team.



Growth Opportunities: As we scale in Germany, this role has the potential to grow into a full-time leadership position.



Flexibility: Part-time hours with flexible scheduling (with some overlap with German business hours).



Long-Term Partnership: We are looking for someone to grow with us for years, not months.



Stable Work: Secure, consistent work with a growing global brand.



How to Apply

Please read carefully. Generic applications will be ignored.



To apply, send your CV and a brief, direct response (max 5 sentences per question) to the following:



What is your experience managing PPC specifically for Amazon Germany (.de) for high-ticket products (€100+)? Please share specific results and the ASIN category if possible.



Describe a time when you successfully reinstated a removed or suppressed listing on Amazon Germany. What was the issue, and what steps did you take to resolve it?



What are the key compliance requirements for selling on Amazon Germany that sellers often overlook?



You are joining an existing PPC team. How would you approach collaborating with them while owning the German market?



What is your availability (hours per week and time zone overlap with German business hours)?



Please include the word "DEUTSCHLAND" at the very top of your application so I know you have read this post carefully.

title: Short-Form Video Editor: Meta Ad Creatives + Content Videos (Per-Video, Long-Term)
description:
Read the whole post before applying. We read every application and can tell fast who skipped it.
 everything to 



ABOUT US

MSET is a lead-generation ad agency in Phoenix, Arizona, built specifically for local home-service businesses (glass installation, roofing, junk removal, remodeling, etc.) If you know how to make a local contractor look like the obvious choice in someone's city, you'll like it here. 



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

A short-form video editor who can cut Meta ad creatives and Hormozi-style content videos, build motion graphics, and match visuals to every beat of a voiceover. 



Real talent: the kind of editor whose work makes people stop scrolling, who places every cut, caption, and sound with intent, and who understands why an ad converts. Reliable, straight with us about what they can and cannot do, and hungry to grow with an agency that pays for performance. If that is you, your samples will show it.



This seat is long-term, not a one-off gig: we are building out our video side and want one editor we grow with, not a rotation of freelancers. Perform, and there is a real path to a creative strategist role with higher pay for editors who think in angles, not just cuts.



WHAT YOU'LL EDIT



1. Meta lead-gen ad creatives, 15-30 seconds. Hook, proof, CTA. High-retention style: clean cuts, animated captions, SFX, punch-ins.

2. Content videos, 45 seconds to 2 minutes. Hormozi-style pacing, dense captions, b-roll drops.

3. Hook variants of existing edits (new first 3 seconds, same timeline).



We record all footage ourselves. Your job is everything after: the cut, the captions, and the graphics. Animated callouts, pop-ups, arrows, price tags, diagrams. You build those graphic elements yourself, not from stock template packs. And every beat of the voiceover gets a visual that matches it: when the VO says a number, the number pops on screen; when it names a problem, we see the problem; when it makes the offer, the offer appears. You pick or build the right visual for each line from our footage, your graphics, or AI b-roll.



Volume: around 3-6 videos per week to start, more if you want more. Typical turnaround 48 hours per video. You choose when you work. No time tracker, no screenshots, no required calls.



MUST HAVE (THE CORE FIVE)

1. Experience editing paid ad creatives (Meta or TikTok ads, not only organic clips)

2. Short-form content editing experience (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

3. Captions AND motion graphics: your own caption styles plus the ability to build overlay graphics (callouts, pop-ups, price tags, diagrams) yourself, not just auto-captions

4. Marketing sense: hooks, offers, retention, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything

5. Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or DaVinci. We judge output, not software.



Creative execution: we hand you the offer and the copy. You know how to bring it to life on screen: how to open the ad, what to show when, where the captions punch, how to make the offer land. Editors who show this grow into a higher-paid seat.



Missing one of these? You can still apply, but you must say which one in your
, listed plainly. Honesty about a gap won't disqualify you. Finding out later will.



STRONGLY PREFERRED (not dealbreakers, but these put you ahead of everyone who skips them)

- Higher quality Hormozi-style content editing experience

- AI video generation experience (Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance) for realistic AI b-roll

- Past work for home-service or local-business ads



WHAT WE PROVIDE

Every job comes as one organized Google Drive folder: script, raw footage, shot list, caption style references, and music direction. You cut. We handle strategy and clients.



PAY (negotiable for the right editor, show us the work)

- $12 per finished ad edit (15-30 seconds)

- $20 per finished content video (45 seconds to 2 minutes)

- $5 per hook variant on an existing edit

- $10 bonus every time one of your ads becomes a top performer in our ad account. Uncapped.

- Raises are written, not verbal: $15 per ad edit and $25 per content video after 3 months of consistent quality.

- Paid weekly via Wise, on time, every week. 2 revision rounds included per video.

- Every delivery includes the project file (Premiere/CapCut/DaVinci source), not just the finished MP4.



Do the math: an ad edit from provided footage and script takes a good editor about an hour, so this is 12 to 24 USD per hour effective, output-based, with zero tracking.



Paid test: shortlisted applicants get one small paid test edit at full rate on real footage. Paid whether or not we hire you. We never ask for free work.



WHAT THIS IS NOT

- Not entry-level, and not an auto-captions-and-export job

- Not a social media manager or thumbnail role. Editing is the core job. Strategy input is welcome and rewarded, never required.

- No mandatory daily quota, no time trackers, no unpaid tests.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word GREENLIGHT so we know you read this. Then do these five things:



1. Direct links to 2-3 paid ad creatives you personally edited (video links, not a portfolio homepage)

2. One link to your best caption-heavy content edit

3.
 
 with the subject line "GREENLIGHT + your name" containing: a Google Drive folder of all your past work (set to "anyone with the link can view") and a short resume of your experience (1 page, editing and marketing work only)

4. Your editing software, your typical turnaround for a 30-second ad, and your internet speed from speedtest.net

5. Pick any ad you think is great and tell us in 2-3 sentences why it works. Be specific about the first 3 seconds.



Optional, for editors who also think in angles: say we hand you this script line for a shower glass company: "10% off your shower glass when you book now, and the estimate is free." In 2-3 sentences, describe the first 5 seconds you would cut: what is on screen, what the captions do, what sound hits.



Use 8 Apply Points in your application. Applications without GREENLIGHT or without direct video links will not be reviewed. We reply to shortlisted applicants within 3 days.
